items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: Quincy Jones wrote that, Quincy was with the band, and that was one of his first arrangements he wrote for a big band.

ctx.x: So when you came, if you left Hampton and came back six months later or a year?

Oh, now the one thing that, one number that really hurted me was when the change was that, his own one of the albums, Love for Sale. Mm-hmm. Quincy Jones wrote that, Quincy was with the band, and that was one of his first arrangements he wrote for a big band. Mm-hmm. And every time, every month, he would take something out and put something in until he just changed the whole arrangement.
Mm-hmm. So you didn't like what Quincy had done? No, I liked what Quincy had done.
